ability.ants.agony.name: Agony
ability.ants.agony.description: Deals 40 damage and stuns for 1 second. The target then moves 30% slower and takes 25% more damage for 6 seconds.
ability.ants.alarm.name: Alarm
ability.ants.alarm.description: Nearby allies deal 35% more damage and attack 15% faster for 6 seconds.
ability.ants.barbed-needles.name: Barbed Needles
ability.ants.barbed-needles.description: Attacks lower the target's armor by 1 for 5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.
ability.ants.bivouac.name: Bivouac
ability.ants.bivouac.description: For 8/10 seconds, the General and up to 24 nearby allies cannot move, take 60/70% less damage and return 35% of melee damage to attackers.
ability.ants.cocoon.name: Cocoon
ability.ants.cocoon.description: Removes negative effects and makes the Queen invulnerable for 6/9/12 seconds. She can still move, attack and cast.
ability.ants.corrosion.name: Corrosion
ability.ants.corrosion.description: Attacks lower the target's armor by 2 for 5 seconds.
ability.ants.crystallise.name: Crystallise
ability.ants.crystallise.description: Encases a unit for 2/3/4 seconds. An enemy is stunned (half as long on heroes); an ally cannot act but is invulnerable.
ability.ants.devour.name: Devour
ability.ants.devour.description: Swallows a non-hero enemy and heals 300 health. The victim takes 35 damage per second for 10 seconds and escapes if the Reaver Queen dies.
ability.ants.found.name: Found
ability.ants.found.description: Lands and becomes a Brood Mound (+8 supply).
ability.ants.frenzy.name: Frenzy
ability.ants.frenzy.description: Every second, nearby small ants gain 6% damage, stacking up to 24%.
ability.ants.fungus-circle.name: Fungus Circle
ability.ants.fungus-circle.description: Allies in the circle heal 15 health per second for 10 seconds.
ability.ants.giant-killer.name: Giant Killer
ability.ants.giant-killer.description: +15 damage against units and heroes of level 3 and up.
ability.ants.guard.name: Guard
ability.ants.guard.description: Nearby small ants take 15% less non-spell damage.
ability.ants.living-light.name: Living Light
ability.ants.living-light.description: Heals an ally for 200/400/600 or deals 100/200/300 damage to an enemy. Cannot target the Queen.
ability.ants.mandible-charge.name: Mandible Charge
ability.ants.mandible-charge.description: Charges an enemy, dealing 80/130/180 damage and stunning it for 1/1.5/2 seconds.
ability.ants.mark-prey.name: Mark Prey
ability.ants.mark-prey.description: An enemy takes 15/25/35% more damage for 12 seconds.
ability.ants.molt.name: Molt
ability.ants.molt.description: Restores 35% of maximum health. For 10 seconds, moves 30% faster but has 3 less armor.
ability.ants.one-body.name: One Body
ability.ants.one-body.description: The Queen and nearby allies take 10/15/20% less damage.
ability.ants.overdose.name: Overdose
ability.ants.overdose.description: For 10 seconds, allies in an area attack 40/60% faster, deal 25/40% more damage and move 20% faster, but lose 10 health per second.
ability.ants.panic.name: Panic
ability.ants.panic.description: Enemies in an area cannot attack or cast for 3 seconds (1.5 on heroes) and move 20% slower. Requires Pheromone Mastery.
ability.ants.plug.name: Plug
ability.ants.plug.description: The Major roots in place, gaining 5 armor and taking 50% less piercing and 30% less siege damage.
ability.ants.rampage.name: Rampage
ability.ants.rampage.description: Charges an enemy. On impact, deals 90 damage and stuns enemies around it for 0.75 seconds.
ability.ants.ravenous.name: Ravenous
ability.ants.ravenous.description: Loses 10 health per second. Only Devour and Molt heal the Reaver Queen.
ability.ants.rebirth.name: Rebirth
ability.ants.rebirth.description: Revives up to 8 nearby dead allies at full health. Revived units deal 25% more damage.
ability.ants.royal-presence.name: Royal Presence
ability.ants.rupture.name: Rupture
ability.ants.spore-cloud.name: Spore Cloud
ability.ants.spore-cloud.description: For 8 seconds, enemies in the cloud attack 40% slower and move 20% slower. Requires Pheromone Mastery.
ability.ants.trail.name: Trail
ability.ants.trail.description: For 12 seconds, allies on the trail move 35% faster.
ability.ants.transfusion.name: Transfusion
ability.ants.transfusion.description: Drains 80/120/160 health from an enemy and heals the most wounded nearby ally for the same amount.
ability.ants.unstable.name: Unstable
ability.ants.unstable.description: Bursts on its first attack or when killed: 100 siege damage to nearby enemies and buildings, 40 to nearby allies.
ability.ants.volatile-draught.name: Volatile Draught
ability.ants.volatile-draught.descriptio: Deals 90/140/190 damage to an enemy and all enemies near it.
ability.ants.war-column.name: War Column
ability.ants.war-column.description: Nearby allies move 10/15/20% faster and deal 10/15/20% more damage.
ability.beetles.arc-surge.name: Arc Surge
ability.beetles.arc-surge.description: Lightning hits 3/5 enemies for 55/75 damage, losing 20% with each jump.
ability.beetles.armor-breaker.name: Armor Breaker
ability.beetles.armor-breaker.descriptio: Attacks lower the target's armor by 3 for 6 seconds.
ability.beetles.barrier-field.name: Barrier Field
ability.beetles.barrier-field.descriptio: Blocks enemy missiles fired from the front at the Warden and allies behind it. The Warden moves 30% slower and drains 2/1 mana per second.
ability.beetles.broadside.name: Broadside
ability.beetles.broadside.description: Deals 140 siege damage to enemies and buildings in an area.
ability.beetles.bulwark-pulse.name: Bulwark Pulse
ability.beetles.bulwark-pulse.descriptio: Shields up to 8 nearby allies for 120/180 damage for 10 seconds. Requires Specialist Training.
ability.beetles.field-repair.name: Field Repair
ability.beetles.field-repair.description: Repairs a machine or building for 45/70 health per second for 4 seconds. Channeled. Requires Specialist Training.
ability.beetles.flak-beam.name: Flak Beam
ability.beetles.furnace-plating.name: Furnace Plating
ability.beetles.lock-shields.name: Lock Shields
ability.beetles.lock-shields.description: The Shieldbearer cannot move and attacks 25% slower, but gains 4 armor and takes 30% less piercing damage.
ability.beetles.mend.name: Mend
ability.beetles.mend.description: Heals an ally or machine for 110/160 health.
ability.beetles.patch-up.name: Patch Up
ability.beetles.patch-up.description: Repairs an allied machine for 60 health.
ability.beetles.static-field.name: Static Field
ability.beetles.static-field.description: For 5 seconds, enemies in an area take 10/15 damage per second and move 25/35% slower. Requires Specialist Training.
ability.coilkeeper.arc-lash.name: Arc Lash
ability.coilkeeper.arc-lash.description: Lightning hits up to 5 enemies for 75/105/135 damage, losing 15% with each jump.
ability.coilkeeper.overload.name: Overload
ability.coilkeeper.overload.description: Burns up to 60/100/140 mana from an enemy, then deals 45/70/95 damage plus the mana burned to it and nearby enemies.
ability.coilkeeper.recharge.name: Recharge
ability.coilkeeper.recharge.description: Allies in an area regain 40/70/100 mana and gain a shield that absorbs 80/130/180 damage for 8 seconds.
ability.coilkeeper.unbottled.name: Unbottled
ability.coilkeeper.unbottled.description: Deals 60/90 damage to nearby enemies and shields nearby allies for 220/320 damage. For 6 seconds, enemies are pulled in and those close by are stunned, while arcs hit up to 6 enemies for 16/24 damage five times a second.
ability.core.holy-light-lite.name: Holy Light
ability.core.holy-light-lite.description: Heals an ally for 100 or deals 50 damage to an enemy.
ability.forgemaster.bolt-turret.name: Bolt Turret
ability.forgemaster.bolt-turret.descript: Builds a turret that attacks ground and air units for 40 seconds. Stronger from rank 2; rank 3 builds two.
ability.forgemaster.field-forge.name: Field Forge
ability.forgemaster.field-forge.descript: Nearby allies gain 2/3/4 armor. Nearby machines and buildings are repaired for 6/10/14 health per second.
ability.forgemaster.forgefall.name: Forgefall
ability.forgemaster.forgefall.descriptio: After 1.5 seconds, an anvil slams an area for 200/300 damage and stuns for 1.5 seconds (half on heroes). The area then burns enemies for 40/64 damage per second for 6 seconds.
ability.forgemaster.overclock.name: Overclock
ability.forgemaster.overclock.descriptio: An ally attacks and moves 30/45/60% faster for 8 seconds.
ability.hornbreaker.colossus.name: Colossus
ability.hornbreaker.colossus.description: For 18/24 seconds, the Hornbreaker gains +300/500 health, +12/20 damage, +3/5 armor and 35/50% cleave.
ability.hornbreaker.horn-rush.name: Horn Rush
ability.hornbreaker.horn-rush.descriptio: Charges a ground enemy, dealing 90/140/190 damage and stunning it for 1/1.5/2 seconds.
ability.hornbreaker.overwhelm.name: Overwhelm
ability.hornbreaker.overwhelm.descriptio: Attacks mark the target, stacking up to 3 times. Each mark adds 5/10/15 damage to the Hornbreaker's attacks against it and slows it by 5/7/10%.
ability.hornbreaker.steadfast.name: Steadfast Aura
ability.hornbreaker.steadfast.descriptio: Nearby allies regenerate 2/3/4 health per second and gain 1/2/3 armor.
